text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The quote from the Project Overview Document's Introduction states the DEI is aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms; the claim restates it faithfully."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Platform Scope section lists exactly three platforms (mobile app, web streaming portal, third-party smart TV integration) and the passage names no social media platform."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"UNSUPPORTED","reason":"The Overview's introduction explicitly mentions 'social platforms' as part of the initiative's aim, so asserting the documents don't describe social media work within scope is not a pure absence statement and is contradicted in part by the cited evidence in the claims' own context."}]}
